scope.reason: A production-code RED reproduced stale SET_CUR poisoning the half-second fallback; flag assignment now occurs only after a matching rate is accepted. ACK/timeout/refusal/packet gates pass.

Production mixer/PCM/codec harness reproduced voice/beep silence and active-voice interruption. Remove music-only codec PDN/wake calls; normal audio init/close owns power. Deliberately defer shared idle savings and warm-wake retiming rather than perform I2C in an IRQ. Idle power/battery cost needs hardware measurement.

Actual portable production C vectors reproduce insufficient alias rejection; native-rate identity and mono/stereo chunk continuity pass. No new bandlimited filter is enabled or implemented: ARM cost, stopband/passband and device battery acceptance remain unvalidated. Optional --require-bandlimit intentionally still fails.

Production sound-policy RED/GREEN demonstrates full tone attenuation retained near volume ceiling on native stereo CS42L55. Neutral/mute/balance/unity-lineout/volume limits and other-codec/simulator/mono guards pass. Boosted playback may be quieter near maximum volume.

Existing stopped-on-failure policy prevents runaway consumption and replay of potentially delivered PCM. Automatic restart requires validated delivery/ownership state and USB-thread fault injection, not arbitrary IRQ retries. Existing batch-failure/startup-recovery tests pass unchanged.
Potential queued old-rate PCM is not yet reproduced in an integrated sink-handover harness. No speculative flush/discard or PCM/mixer rate-lifecycle change is included.

UAC1 feedback and full-speed DAC behind high-speed hub limitations remain. No validated feedback association/clock-drift implementation or physical compatible DAC/hub test is available for this candidate; Lexus iAP is a separate path.

Actual UAC1/UAC2 initialization RED/GREEN replaces unconditional maximum with supported unity-or-lower gain aligned to MIN/RES, reads back SET_CUR, and leaves unknown/failed/malformed/multi-range controls unchanged. Does not certify physical loudness or guarantee safe behavior of arbitrary DAC firmware.

Actual asynchronous HID RED/GREEN now delivers finite play/power/shuffle/repeat/stopped/extended-state events before recurring PCM clocks, preserving queue/UID/caps order and subscription gating. Captured Lexus fixture continues to pass.
